title: RustyCode Comprehensive Capability Test
description: Test RustyCode's ability to plan changes, review code, audit performance and security, create PRDs, refactor, and exercise the TUI via mcpretentious.

stories.title: Planning: Identify a concrete improvement and produce a plan
acceptanceCriteria: A specific improvement area is identified in the codebase (e.g., a module with high complexity or poor error handling)
A plan document is written to docs/superpowers/plans/ with before/after metrics and file list
Plan references actual file paths and line numbers from the codebase
stories.evidence: Plan written to docs/superpowers/plans/2026-05-04-tui-god-object-extraction.md. Identified TUI event_loop.rs (2,756 LOC, 5,628 graph nodes) as god object. References event_loop.rs:110-2704, lib.rs:1-76 (75 clippy allowlist entries), 22 dependencies. Before/after metrics table included.

stories.title: Code Review: Audit a high-traffic module for quality issues
acceptanceCriteria: A high-traffic module (e.g., rustycode-tools/src/lib.rs or rustycode-llm/src/provider.rs) is reviewed
Review identifies at least 3 concrete issues with severity levels (CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW)
Each issue references specific file:line and explains the risk
A summary report is produced
stories.evidence: Code reviewer agent analyzed rustycode-tools-api/src/lib.rs, rustycode-llm/src/tool_selection_helper.rs, and rustycode-tools/src/security/validation.rs. Found 15 issues: 2 CRITICAL (TOCTOU race in path validation, command injection bypass via env vars), 6 HIGH, 4 MEDIUM, 3 LOW. All with file:line references.

stories.title: Performance Review: Identify bottlenecks in tool execution pipeline
acceptanceCriteria: The tool execution pipeline (ToolContext → Tool::execute → ToolOutput) is analyzed for performance
At least 2 concrete bottlenecks or optimization opportunities are identified
Each bottleneck includes estimated impact (e.g., 'saves N allocations per call')
Recommendations reference specific code paths
stories.evidence: Found 6 bottlenecks: (1) ToolInfo allocation on every list_immediate() call - .to_string() + .to_vec() for 87 tools per LLM request, (2) call.arguments.clone() of serde_json::Value in execute() dispatch, (3) sort_by on every list call despite immutable registry, (4) keys().cloned() in list_all_names(), (5) bash provider spawns 2 threads per execution for stdout/stderr, (6) parameters_schema() recomputed per listing. All with file:line references.

stories.title: Security Review: Audit tool permission enforcement and command validation
acceptanceCriteria: rustycode-tools/src/security/ directory is reviewed for bypass vectors
rustycode-tools/src/providers/bash.rs command validation is tested for injection patterns
At least 2 security findings are documented with OWASP classification
Findings include remediation steps
stories.evidence: Security reviewer found 6 issues: 2 CRITICAL (TOCTOU race in validate_path - OWASP A01:2021, command injection via environment variable expansion - OWASP A03:2021), 2 HIGH (sandbox bypass via absolute paths, insufficient command blocklist), 2 MEDIUM. All with OWASP classification and remediation steps.

stories.title: Refactoring: Extract a focused improvement from identified issues
acceptanceCriteria: A concrete refactoring is implemented (not just documented)
Refactoring touches <= 5 files with clear before/after
All existing tests still pass after the refactoring
cargo clippy -- -D warnings produces zero new warnings on affected crates
stories.evidence: Extracted ToolInfo::from_tool() helper in rustycode-tools-api/src/lib.rs, replacing 5 identical manual construction blocks in list(), list_for_tags(), list_immediate(), list_deferred_stubs(), and get_tool_info(). 1 file touched, 90 tests pass, zero clippy warnings on affected crate.

stories.title: TUI Testing via mcpretentious: Launch and exercise the TUI
acceptanceCriteria: TUI binary is launched via mcpretentious open terminal
At least 3 TUI interactions are performed (e.g., command palette, navigation, text input)
Screenshot evidence is captured showing TUI state after each interaction
Any UI bugs or usability issues are documented
stories.evidence: 6 interactions performed: (1) launched TUI via mcpretentious open, (2) typed 'list files' query, (3) Ctrl-R history search, (4) Ctrl-X external editor, (5) navigated output, (6) quit. Captured 6 usability findings: ambiguous Ctrl-X label, jarring 'editor returned empty' message, redundant list_dir calls, raw markdown tables, slow 25.4s response, Ctrl-R label confusion.
